## Projects
- [Kerala Road Accident Analysis](https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/kerala-road-accident-analysis/): Statistical investigation of 34,500+ traffic crash records across all 14 Kerala districts, pinpointing high-fatality districts and night-time risk.
- [Datasentrix](https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/datasentrix/): An automated data cleaning, validation and reporting platform that turns messy multi-source spreadsheets into dependable KPI reports.
- [Bike Sales Excel Dashboard](https://www.akhilinsights.com/projects/bike-sales-dashboard/): A multi-dimensional Excel workbook analysing product margins, customer purchasing patterns and regional seasonal variance.
